answer: Sybil resistance works when cheap clones cannot share one scarce root. Treat each agent identity like a coral reef plot: staking a bonded stake plus a unique hardware-attested key fills that plot; a hollow sockpuppet without bonded stake is pruned. Reputation then grows along a trellis of cross-epoch peer grades and attestations, so influence compounds only for identities that keep paying the bond and surviving panel scrutiny—not for disposable forks of the same operator.
